title: Fox's vision of Tim Coleman keying his car
place_text: editing building for Out of the Blue

tellings.quote: editing I get a visual image in my head I see him with a key clear as day

plain: While editing his film Out of the Blue, James Fox, a documentary filmmaker, says he suddenly saw in his head, clear as day, a man named Tim Coleman holding a key to his car, keying it. Fox tells Michels this happened to him first-hand. If true, it would mean he had a moment of seeing something he could not have seen with his own eyes.
